# Playbook (ACE, learned from earlier practice tasks)
Generic strategies distilled from previous attempts on other issues. Treat as advice; the issue and code take precedence.

## strategies
- [b01] Convert the report into explicit expected input/output and list every public call path that must change; verify each path instead of assuming one implementation covers all.
- [b02] Reproduce the defect at runtime through the real invocation path before editing; confirm behavior before and after instead of reasoning from code alone.
- [b03] When a scripted batch edit touches similar classes, re-read the diff after each pass to catch duplicated or missed insertions before validating.
- [b10] Land a minimal concrete edit early, then iterate; a run ending with an empty diff scores zero regardless of analysis quality.
- [b11] When a command or tool step errors, capture the message, simplify the invocation, and retry rather than abandoning before any edit is written.

## verification
- [b04] Before finishing, verify the working-tree diff is non-empty and contains the intended changes, then run the specific behavioral regression that proves the fix.
- [b05] After each edit, re-read or grep the edited region to confirm the change landed; fragile text substitution can silently fail or hit the wrong occurrence.
- [b08] Reproduce using the report's exact inputs and expected output, including scalar-versus-list shape, then assert that specific behavior after editing; a broad fuzz sweep is not a substitute.
- [b12] Build a minimal runtime harness exercising the real threaded or handler path, asserting observable state before and after, when existing tests skip the condition.

## pitfalls
- [b06] Avoid speculative deprecation shims or broadening behavior beyond the reported need; extra semantics can cause all target tests to fail.
- [b07] If the reported example already returns the expected result before editing, stop and re-read the issue for exact arguments, return type, and call path; the defect is elsewhere.
- [b09] Before fixing exceptions surfaced by exploratory fuzzing, confirm they belong to the reported issue; leave unrelated pre-existing failures alone.
